data.title: 矢来美羽 · 暖灯卧榻的靠近邀约
data.description: 夜灯柔和的卧室床榻上铺着深灰亚麻被单，矢来美羽单膝微曲侧坐在床沿，身体微微前倾，指尖轻点身旁空出的床位。褪去白天干练的守望者外壳，墨黑真丝钢圈内衣衬得她白皙肌肤格外耀眼，微红眼角流露出难得直白的撒娇与依恋。
data.location: 暖暗夜灯笼罩的深夜卧房深灰大床
data.action: 侧坐床沿微微前倾，轻拍身旁床榻发出柔声邀约
data.lighting: 床头暖琥珀柔光聚焦肩颈锁骨与蕾丝纹路
data.camera: 微俯中近景，拉近眼神交流与私密呼吸感
data.mood: 亲昵、热烈、卸防后的坦率邀约
data.promptProse: Seated on the edge of the dark linen bed beneath a warm amber lamp, Miu leans gently forward with one palm resting on the sheets beside her as a quiet invitation. Warm light plays over her fair skin, the crimson rose lace accents of her black silk bra, and the sleek waist straps.
data.animaCaption: Leaning forward on the lamplit dark linen bed, she rests one hand on the sheets in a soft invitation.
data.nsfwProse: Leaning forward in the warm bedside glow accentuates the deep-V black silk lace cups and crisscross waist straps.
